metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Astro - agent workflow and platform integrations

plugins.name: agent-toast
plugins.description: Claude Stop-hook desktop notification integration for Windows/WSL, macOS, and Linux. ThreatLocker-safe Windows path; configurable name, session label, icon, and beep.

plugins.name: godmode-dev-flow
plugins.description: Bundled story delivery lifecycle for Claude Code. Installs four skills: project-setup (classify and bootstrap a repository), disciplined-coding (scoped diffs and verifiable success criteria), start-story-multi-agent (Claude implements, Codex reviews read-only, human owns PR and merge gates), and close-story (worktree and branch cleanup after merge).
